scripts.dev: npm run build -w @pokecenter/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,client,server "npm run dev -w @pokecenter/shared" "npm run dev -w @pokecenter/client" "npm run dev -w @pokecenter/server"
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w @pokecenter/shared && npm run dev -w @pokecenter/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @pokecenter/shared && npm run dev -w @pokecenter/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pokecenter/shared && tsc -p apps/client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pokecenter/shared && npm run build -w @pokecenter/client && npm run build -w @pokecenter/server
